verified.note: Confirmed no pre-existing FixedAsset schema; no lib/Db/ Mapper classes for fixed_asset or depreciation.
Spec file present with Status/Scope/Tier/Depends-on header, REQ-FA-001 through REQ-FA-007, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios.
Proposal present with kind:config, Affected Projects, Scope, Risks, Rollback, Open Questions.
Design present with D1-D4 decisions (declarative lifecycle, derived fields, parallel streams, ScheduledWorkflow) and Reuse Analysis table.

FixedAsset schema declared with all 19 REQ-FA-002 fields (assetNumber, name, assetCategory, acquisitionDate, acquisitionCost, currency, usefulLifeMonths, residualValue, depreciationMethod, degressiveRate, commercialRate, fiscalRate, assetAccountNumber, accumulatedDepAccountNumber, depreciationExpenseAccountNumber, disposalDate, disposalAccountingTreatment, lifecycleState, administrationId).

ScheduledWorkflow object registered in components.objects for monthly depreciation run targeting active FixedAsset records via monthlyDepreciation calculated field. No DepreciationJob extends TimedJob class created.
Fixed Assets navigation entry added under Bookkeeping menu. FixedAssets (type:index) and FixedAssetDetail (type:detail) pages declared with full field config and lifecycleActions:true.
FixedAsset entry reconciled with new canonical field set, calculated fields listed, GLLine.subLedgerRef relation documented, reconciliation note added.
